reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves Customer's right to sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, and §5 (p0023) sets fees as a revenue share on activity actually generated, with no spend floor, volume cap, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic.

Rationale correctly distinguishes non-triggering 'minimum' references (Customer-set Winning Bid Price floor; Vendor's no-guaranteed-revenue disclaimer) and correctly treats the one-year initial term as a termination-timing issue outside MINCOMMIT's scope.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed; the rendered text is identical to the original and deterministic checks are clean, so nothing to remediate.
